english_title: 19. His Supplication in Asking for Water during a Drought

phrases.english: 1.O God, water us with rain,
2.unfold upon us Your mercy through Your copious rain

phrases.arabic: مِنَ الْسَّحَابِ الْمُنْسَـاقِ لِنَبَاتِ أَرْضِكَ الْمُونِقِ فِي جَمِيـعِ الآفَاقِ،
phrases.english: 3.from the driven clouds, so that Your goodly earth may grow on all horizons!
4.Show kindness to Your servants through the ripening of the fruit,
5.revive Your land through the blossoming of the flowers,
6.and let Your angels - the noble scribes - be witness
7.to a beneficial watering from You, lasting in its abundance,
8.plenty in its flow, heavy, quick, soon,

phrases.arabic: تُحْيِي بِهِ مَا قَدْ مَات، وَتَرُدُّ بهِ مَا قَدْ فَاتَ،
phrases.english: 9.through which You revivest what has died, returnest what has vanished,
10.bringest forth what is coming,
11.and providest plentiful foods,
12.through heaped up, wholesome, productive clouds, in reverberating layers,
13.the rain's downpour not without cease,
14.the lightning's flashes not without fruit!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مَغيثَاً مَرِيعاً مُمْرِعاً عَرِيْضَاً،
phrases.english: 15.O God, give us water through rain, helping, productive, fertilizing, widespread,

phrases.arabic: وَاسِعاً غَزِيراً تَرُدُّ بِهِ النَّهِيضَ وَتَجْبُرُ بِهِ الْمَهِيضَ.
phrases.english: 16.plentiful, abundant, bringing back the risen, restoring the broken!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا سَقْياً تُسِيلُ مِنْهُ الظِّرابَ،
phrases.english: 17.O God, give us water with a watering through which You wilt make the stone hills pour,
18.fill the cisterns,
19.flood the rivers,
20.make the trees grow,

phrases.arabic: وَتُرْخِصُ بِهِ الأسْعَارَ فِي جَمِيع الأمْصَارِ،
phrases.english: 21.bring down prices in all the lands,
22.invigorate the beasts and the creatures,
23.perfect for us the agreeable things of provision,
24.make grow for us the fields,
25.let flow for us the teats,
26.and add for us strength to our strength!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْ ظِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا سَمُوماً
phrases.english: 27.O God, make not the cloud's shadow over us a burning wind,
28.allow not its coldness to be cutting,
29.let not its pouring down upon us be a stoning,
30.and make not its waters for us bitter!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
phrases.english: 31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
32.and provide us with the blessings of the heavens and the earth!
33."Thou art powerful over everything"! (3:26)
